sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The RB-PP key (RB-PP) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Radar Station bomb shelter under the Federal State Reserve Agency base. Doesn't seem to be actually used for anything though, at least for now.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - This key does currently not open any lock.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs
